background.png.purpose: sky/cloud/castle plate with dragon and title removed
background.png.prompt_summary: Preserve sunset pixel-art scene; remove dragon and all lettering, reconstruct occluded sky.

dragon-poses.png.purpose: four articulated wing poses on transparent 2x2 sheet
dragon-poses.png.prompt_summary: Same blue and orange dragon facing right; fixed torso/head, upstroke, mid-down, downstroke, mid-up. Transparent background.

cloud-strip.png.prompt_summary: Single seamless horizontal purple-blue and peach-gold pixel-art cloud band, true alpha, no castle/text, matching reference sunset.

dragon-poses-8.png.purpose: eight articulated wing keyframes on transparent 4x2 sheet
dragon-poses-8.png.prompt_summary: Use the four-pose dragon as reference. Keep torso, face, legs, tail and scale fixed while wings move through an eight-frame upstroke/downstroke cycle. True alpha, no grid or text.

dragon-rig.png.purpose: fixed body plus separately articulated near/far wings
dragon-rig.png.prompt_summary: Decompose reference blue dragon into wingless body and two fully spread wings on transparent background, preserve design and shoulder pivots.

sky.png.purpose: scrolling cloud sky without solid landmarks
sky.png.prompt_summary: Remove castle and mountains from background plate, replace with matching sunset clouds. Preserve mood and pixel art; horizontally repeating sky.

front-cloud.png.purpose: rounded foreground cloud that partially occludes the castle
front-cloud.png.prompt_summary: Single broad rounded purple-peach sunset cloud on true alpha, designed for native64x32, organic top and bottom, no thin ribbon, no waterlike lines; reference approved title colors.

title-glyph-mask.png.purpose: binary silhouette of original logo, IV and subtitle; source RGB unchanged
title-glyph-mask.png.method: contour mask checked against original native pixels, excluding sky gaps and isolated background fragments

invariants: logo and subtitle use original source pixels
animation is newly authored SFC adaptation, not extracted NDS graphics
